title: Innovative Approaches for Personalised Cardiovascular Prevention
official: Innovative Approaches for Personalised Cardiovascular Prevention: Multicenter Randomised Controlled Study and Multidisciplinary Evaluation for a National Health Service (NHS) Implementation
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* high cardiovascular risk based on the SCORE 2 (between 2.5% and 10%)
* age between 40 and 69 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* diabetes.
* familiar hypercholesterolemia.
* established CVD.
sponsor: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS

sites.f: Dipartimento Universitario di Scienze della Vita e Sanità Pubblica
